changelog: BIM-Bot v2.7.5 — fresh build of everything in 2.7.4, with the Navisworks connection re-verified live on Navisworks Manage 2024. Includes: navis_capture_view / navis_capture_clash (images the AI can see), the Clash Snapshots button and navis_export_clash_snapshots, the Navisworks <-> Revit clash bridge (navis_clash_to_revit, revit_selection_to_navis, navis_recheck_clash, navis_clash_handoff_table, navis_refresh_models) that works on federated NWD models, the manual bridge session (Navisworks BIM-Bot Bridge + Revit Join Bridge, navis_bridge_status), and OpenCode auto-connect. No functional changes since 2.7.4.
